# AWS X-Ray trace ingestion and telemetry runtime

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Extend records-only groups and sampling rules to trace ingestion, telemetry processing, and service map analysis.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] PutTraceSegments
- [ ] PutTelemetryRecords
- [ ] GetTraceSummaries
- [ ] BatchGetTraces
- [ ] GetServiceGraph
- [ ] GetSamplingTargets
- [ ] PutEncryptionConfig and PutResourcePolicy

## Integration decisions

The current X-Ray API persists group and sampling rule configuration records only; trace ingestion and graph generation are excluded.
